data.description: CNT-09 (w2), CNT-11 (w2), feeds CNT-12 (w3) — the largest lever in the content area; the triage assumed an editor that does not exist. patchDraft hard-rejects non-drafts (submission-record.routes.ts:793) and the record page renders its editor only for drafts — organizers cannot edit accepted session content AT ALL. (1) Extend the record editor to accepted/scheduled (explicit status allowlist; published behind a confirm). (2) Every write emits before/after audit rows composed into the same batch() as the change (src/lib/audit.ts:50-66 pattern). (3) LIFT the portal's proven history machinery (historyFor at portal.routes.ts:868-889 already joins people for actor_name and renders 'Priya Raman - 12 Aug - updated title') into src/lib/history.ts; add the missing people-join to the admin history query (~2 lines) and stop rendering the literal string 'user' (SubmissionRecordPage.tsx:173 prints actor_kind). (4) RESTORE IS A FORWARD EDIT: re-apply before_json through the same write path, emit content_restored with its own before/after; never rewrite or delete audit rows. Ownership: you own session content editing + the history component on the submission record; the roster ticket owns the speaker record and consumes your component. Full spec: section T-G. Register row 30.
data.title: Organizer content editing with named history and restore

data.body:
PR #84 open — https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/84

LOCAL GATE (mandatory, pasted per COMMON.md):
  npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-118
  {"command":"pr-gate","ticket":"MRQ-118","status":"pass","elapsedMs":81394,"budgetMs":120000}
  Checks: worker types, client types, test types, production build, design contract, API contract, hermetic fast suite, merged AC trace — all green.

SHIPPED: PATCH .../submissions/{id}/content + POST .../content/restore (both program:write, explicit status allowlist, published behind confirm_published); src/lib/history.ts as the one human-facing audit_log reader (portal's historyFor lifted into it, admin query gains the people join); src/ui/history/ContentHistory.tsx as the shared component T-D1 consumes (ownership rule 7); restore as a forward edit that appends content_restored and never touches an existing row. No migration.

REVIEW: single headless reviewer, 3 rounds, ended PASS (artifact attached). Caught 2 blockers + 2 regressions my own fixes introduced. Notably it forced splitting actions.can_edit_content from actions.can_restore_content: drafts save through patchDraft/requireDraftRead (form admins hold that, AC-247-249) while restore has one door requiring program:write at every status — one shared flag was wrong for somebody in either direction.

VALIDATION: CNT-S3 steps 7-9 and 15 driven against a running Worker (vite dev + real seed, signed in via the product's own auth door). Edit persists across reload, list reflects the new title, two named timestamped entries, restore drops sentence 2 and keeps sentence 1, exact original title returns.

DEVIATE-WITH-FLAG (2, for the Orchestrator):
1. The ticket says 'extend the editor to accepted/scheduled'. There is no 'scheduled' status — a scheduled Session's status is still 'accepted'; placement is an agenda_items row and publication is agenda_items.is_published. The allowlist is therefore over submissions.status and the published confirm keys off the slot. No contract doc edited.
2. CNT-11's pass_criteria names attribution 'to Jordan Alvarez' (the eval-kit persona). Our demo organizer seat resolves to 'AIE Program Committee', so the panel attributes to that name. The mechanism is right — it renders whoever holds the seat — but the seat's NAME is scoring surface owned by the auth/persona tickets (T-A / T-N3, register row 50), not by me. Worth a look before the next eval run.

INCIDENTAL (small, general, flag if unwanted): vitest.node.config.ts gained a Preact JSX setting. The node project had no .tsx support at all — a UI import failed as 'cannot find react/jsx-dev-runtime', which reads as a missing dependency rather than a missing setting. This is why no UI component in the repo had a render test. Also regenerated cli/api-registry.json for the two new operations (check:api enforces parity).

ACCEPTED-NOT-FIXED: no optimistic concurrency (concurrency:'none'), consistent with every other submission write; only agenda.routes.ts uses if-match. Named because an honest-history feature is where it costs most.

Status: pr_open. Not merging — a human merges.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: verified DONE. PR #84 (mrq-118-content-history) merged 2026-08-12T14:26:09Z; merge commit dd184404 confirmed an ancestor of github/main via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'. Ticket had drifted at pr_open. The repo has zero open and zero closed-unmerged PRs, so nothing is waiting on review. Status corrected to reflect merge, not PR-open.
